review_evidence: README identifies the Equational Theories project and its formal study/database of implications and nonimplications among magma equations.

The 1301 current-primary Lean files include core magma/equational infrastructure, manually proved results, generated finite-model/refutation and rewrite theorem files, and two Lean extraction/export tools with reusable data structures/algorithms.

Inspection of generated refutation/rewrite modules and scripts shows that generated-labelled files encode the actual formal proof/search results and the scripts define project-specific extraction/closure interfaces; neither class is content-lossless boilerplate.
summary: Retain the complete Equational Theories corpus, including generated proof/refutation results and Lean extraction scripts; no safe hard exclusion was established.
